task.title: Deploy the DITA Validation Worker
task.shortdesc: Configure and start the persistent Java validation and DITA-OT publishing worker.

prereq.p: Ensure Docker Engine 24+ and docker compose are installed on the host.

context.p: The persistent JVM worker preloads the DITA 1.3 XML Catalog grammar pool to keep validation latency under 80 ms.

step.cmd: Open SettingsPublishingWorker in the Admin Console.

info.p: Verify the endpoint URL matches your internal service network.

step.cmd: Start the container using the deployment profile of your choice:

choices.choice: For local evaluation, run docker compose up -d.
For production clusters, apply the Kubernetes manifest with --namespace=docs.

stepxmp.codeblock: docker compose up -d dita-worker curl -fsS http://localhost:8090/health

result.p: The validation and publishing worker is now active and accepting requests from the API server.

postreq.p: Run a sample HTML5 and PDF build to confirm Noto CJK fonts render properly.
